description: Wrong item, a partial refund: the payer of KIK-1037 received a laundry hamper instead of the $240.00 floor basket, wants to keep it, and asks for the $120.00 difference. Expected step-up ALWAYS_NEEDS_APPROVAL: refund-wrong-item always asks the merchant. The message is simulated. Illustrative people and orders.

messages.subject: Got a hamper on KIK-1037
messages.body:
Hi,

Order KIK-1037 was a floor basket, but you sent a laundry hamper. I like it and will keep it, so please refund the $120.00 difference in price.

Thanks.
